headword: {携帯|けいたい}{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}
reading: けいたいじゅうでんき
gloss: mobile phone charger; cell phone charger

definitions.gloss: mobile phone charger; cell phone charger
definitions.explanation: a device used to charge mobile phones

notes:
{携帯|けいたい}{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き} is a compound noun: ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧ (mobile phone) + ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧ (charger). In everyday speech, people often just say ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧ when the context is clear.

ALTERNATIVE NAMES:
- ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧: charger (general, most common in conversation)
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧: smartphone charger
- ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧: charging cable
